description: This file contains functions for rendering XML documentation comments from Markdown nodes, including handling of special nodes, code blocks, and links, specifically for .NET XML documentation generation.

methods.name: renderXmlDoc
methods.description: Generates XML documentation comments from Markdown nodes, adding summary and remarks sections.

methods.name: _innerRenderNodes
methods.description: Processes Markdown nodes into summary and remarks parts, handling list items, code blocks, and notes.

methods.name: _wrapCode
methods.description: Escapes special characters in code lines and formats them for XML inclusion.

methods.name: _wrapInNode
methods.description: Wraps content in specified XML tags, handling single or multiple nodes.

methods.name: _wrapAndEscape
methods.description: Converts Markdown node text into XML-safe lines with link and code formatting.

methods.name: _nodeShouldBeIgnored
methods.description: Determines if a Markdown node should be ignored based on its content.

methods.name: renderTextOnly
methods.description: Renders only the textual summary from Markdown nodes, ignoring other parts.
